tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms & conditions are as per tender documents.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: a)All ASRTU RC Rate Contract sources are eligible to participate in the tender. OR Manufacturers of Automotive Cables & Wires with a minimum annual average turnover of Rs.2.00 Crores for the preceding continuous three years out of four years (i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) are eligible to participate duly supported by the Audited Statement of Accounts i.e., Manufacturing / Trading and Profit & Loss Account, Balance Sheets for all the three years. and b)The bidder has to submit the test reports of the quoted brand conforming to the tender specifications from any of the reputed laboratory namely, CIRT/ARAI/NABL accredited State /Central Government owned laboratory.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- SUBMIT THE DOCUMENTS AS PER THE PREQUALIFICATION CRITERIA OF THE TENDER.

Any other documents in respect of Prequalification criteria and other Terms and conditions of tender.
Audited Statement of Accounts-Profit & Loss Account and Balance Sheet- for the preciding continuous three years out of four years i.e. 2022-23,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26

Certificate of Incorporation/ Certificate of Registration issued by the Registrar of Companies/ Industries and Commerce Dept in proof of manufacturing status-along with MOA or Annexures/ enclosures to certificate

Declaration-I as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/- or above

Declaration-II as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/- or above-In case the manufacturers/ Principal firm will execute supplies through their Channel Partner/ Authorized Dealer/ Distributor
Declaration-III as per the format on Govt. stamp paper of Rs. 20/- or above
MSME Certificate / Udyog Aadhar certificate / NSIC certificate / SSI Certificate etc.. Is a proof of manufacturer of tendered items / services.
NSIC certificate-to avail exemption from the payment of Earnest Money Deposit
Test reports of the quoted brand conforming to the tender specifications from any of the reputed laboratory namely, CIRT / ARAI / NABL accredited State / Central Government owned laboratory.
